item.description:
Make the most of being stuck at home with the Monopoly At Home Reality game. This family board game celebrates the new way of living. Board spaces are rooms in the house -- the bedroom is the office, the living room is the movie theater, and the kitchen is the school.
The gameplay is similar to the standard Monopoly board game but with humorous differences. Tokens can't share a space because of social distancing, and players will want to watch out for the screaming child because they'll have to pay to entertain the kid.
This version of the Monopoly game makes the most of life at home with social distancing and missed activities like visiting a movie theater, yoga studio, and more.
HILARIOUS TOKENS: Racecar with parking boot, Rubber duck with babies, T-Rex with boxer shorts, smaller dog, penguin with coffee cup, Cat with bath cap., UPDATED UTILITIES AND HOME-THEMED BOARD SPACES: In this family board game, WiFi and video streaming are necessary utilities, and board spaces are places in the home, such as the kitchen turned school. AVOID THE SCREAMING CHILD: When a player moves their token, they also move the screaming child; if the tokens land on the same space, the player must pay to entertain the screaming child.
"Community Chest" becomes the "Community Cupboard". Chance is still called Chance, but is now illustrated with boxes shipped from online orders.
The money tweaks the classic design to look like a house, and each denomination features different food items inside the 'house'.

item.description:
Official Monopoly game for the City of Ath in Belgium.
Properties include La Jardinerie de Beloeil, Chez Pauchea, Le Drink des Primeveres, La Jeune Chambre D'Ath, and Chez Loiselet.
La ville d’Ath est attestée depuis le Moyen-Age. En 1166, le comte du Hainaut Baudouin IV fait construire un puissant donjon, la tour Burbant, au confluent des Dendres orientale et occidentale. Peu à peu, une cité se crée et se développe. L’église Saint-Julien avec son clocher caractéristique est édifiée au début du 15ème siècle. L’hôtel de ville baroque remonte au règne des Archiducs Albert et Isabelle. Enfin, au milieu du 17ème siècle, le maréchal Vauban fortifie la cité et en fait une des plus belles place-fortes d’Europe.
Mais aujourd’hui, ce sont des personnages gigantesques qui font la renommée d’Ath. Goliath et son épouse, et tous leurs congénères, sont les emblèmes de la Ducasse, reconnue chef-d’œuvre de l’humanité par l’Unesco. Chaque année, le quatrième week-end d’Août, des milliers de visiteurs se donnent rendez-vous à Ath pour vibrer au rythme des Géants.
—description from the publisher

item.description:
A monopoly (from Greek monos μόνος (alone or single) + polein πωλεῖν (to sell)) exists when a specific person or enterprise is the only supplier of a particular commodity.
Monopoly is a roll-and-move game where players move around the game board buying or trading properties, developing their properties with houses and hotels. When opponents land on players owned property, the owning player collects rent from the landing player. Owning sets of properties increases the rent paid to the player who owns them, by the player who lands on the square. The ultimate goal is to have the most money and drive opponents into bankruptcy.
The classic Monopoly with constructions and other elements from Auckland, in New Zealand.
